_comment: co-agent panel defaults. Override per-repo/personal in .claude/co-agent.local.json (gitignored) via /co-agent:configure. Only settings the CLIs actually accept headlessly are here: model (all 3), effort (Codex only), enabled, timeout. context_limit = model context window in tokens; the fan-out skips an AI whose window can't hold the context instead of hard-failing (Kiro/Gemini ~1M, Codex gpt-5.x ~272K). sync_on_change: when true, the CLAUDE.md PostToolUse hook tells Claude to run /co-agent:sync-context automatically once the generated files exist (opt-in; default off = reminder only).
